notes.title: The Enhanced Driving Update is out NOW!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36744579/93e21c88d437a1527feddfc67cdc470b6ac04e47.jpg

The Enhanced Driving Update is live NOW on PC and Consoles!

Core Update Changes: 

 Brake Overheat Simulation
 Vehicle Paint/Lighting/Physics Overhaul
 Manual Transmission for Controllers
 Remodeled Wheels & Truck Exteriors 
 Vastly Improved Multiplayer Synchronization
 New Dynamic Camera
 Smarter Recovery System
 Bug Fixes & Optimization

Watch the Enhanced Driving Update trailer here: [previewyoutube=HrgsW4AOlow;full][/previewyoutube]

Check Out Our Enhanced Vehicles!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36744579/8b2bcf927ef207d1e6e7fe367d8e524dc800653f.png

New clean looks! We dedicated a lot of time to increasing the quality of our vehicles. Vehicle paint has been remade with better lighting, reflections, and looks. Almost every vehicle and trailer has brand new wheels with unique designs and brakes! More wheel damage has also been added, where hub-caps of some vehicles will pop off. Heavy truck trailer now have a king pin for trailer connections to add to the visual realism. New mirrors, door handles, and more details have been added to our MAN and Scania trucks!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36744579/aaad7eebf0484e243815651777592367efa85dc4.gif

Let there be light! Our MAN and Scania truck's headlights have been completely remade in 3D! All vehicle headlights have been remade to now have daytime driving lights for better visibility on the road. All vehicle and trailer brake/reverse lights now light up the environment. Trucks and trailers have received more marker lights for brighter and cleaner looks. We hope you love the new looks of our vehicles and trailers!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36744579/47c4a475893a4e71724c09ea7a939aba3a8d67ab.gif

Have more control over YOUR vehicles! Brake overheat simulation has been added to all vehicles and trailers. Brakes are fully simulated with proper calculations for heat. When your brakes overheat, you will experience a loss in braking power and control!
We heard our community LOUD and CLEAR. Manual transmission is now supported on controllers, giving you a new layer of control. With a complete remake of vehicle wheel colliders, you'll experience more immersive and realistic physics with accurate suspension inertia and more.  
The camera systems for both the interior and exterior have been remade. Using the acceleration of the vehicle, road forces, and impacts, it properly offsets & rotates the camera, giving a better feeling of physics and movement. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36744579/1ff64fb32e9bbb72a54260582e4adc91c1cff7ae.gif

Enhancing Your Quality of Life!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36744579/c2790ba44da8f791326a46a487bc739e72c79046.png

Better connecting you with your friends! We have completely rewritten the code that handles multiplayer position tracking and synchronization. No longer should you see other players stopping and freezing due to latency and ping. Additionally other players should now move more fluently on the road especially when at high speeds. Thanks to the brand new daytime lights for vehicles and new marker lights for trailers, it is now much easier to see and be seen on the road!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36744579/15037d66cbf394500866e06697b47112c5f2b3b6.gif

A faster and smoother experience! We dedicated a lot of time to optimizing the game for a better all-around experience. The reflection and mirror system for vehicles and the environment has been completely rewritten to enhance performance on all platforms. Vegetation loading stuttering has been reduced, and lighting and reflections on car surfaces and interiors have been optimized. Console render distances for reflections and mirrors have been improved, especially for lower graphic settings. Additionally, shadows have been significantly optimized and their quality enhanced. Finally we improved the UI and vehicle recovery systems to improve the overall experience for everyone!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36744579/0af2a3e0113588e046570ddabc693ce238f22b19.png

Our Efforts to the Community!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36744579/cfa7ce2d565f7a4822a2fe4d0c43995c176ff93e.png

Your feedback has been invaluable! Your feedback after release was amazing, and it has helped us has shaped this update to be what it is. We listen to each and every comment you all leave both here, on Discord, and our other socials! We want to thank all of you for influencing the development of this update. So many changes were added by request of YOU!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36744579/e41e38c4ab3f527f08bbc90587f572afb9f927f0.png

Bugs be GONE! This update has by far the most amount of bug fixes to date and we could not have fixed all of them without you! Thank you for reporting issues and bugs to us and being patient with us as we fix them! Check out the full change-log to see just a small handful of the issues we have fixed thanks to YOU.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36744579/d4e4bc25ee13f7cce5dc7c1a06e3c65c3d14e663.png

You can find the patch notes for the update here: Trello - Change Log 

See you on the road!
Your Truck & Logistics Simulator Team

notes.title: December Update | V1.011 | Truck & Logistics Simulator
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36744579/976f3be0571540cccc6aadd82a3525f711d3df96.jpg

The Truck & Logistics Simulator December Update just went live!

In addition to a significant performance boost, you can expect better graphics with improved shadows and contrast.

A Fast Travel option and UI changes await you, such as being able to hide your minimap in first person. The option to invert the camera Y-Axis got added, mission income got adjusted, manual gearbox issue is fixed, and many more improvements and bugfixes.

Full Changelog

Optimization & Graphical Changes:

 Significantly improved performance
 Better shadows and contrast
 Improved vegetation popping

Gameplay Changes:

 Added fast travel. After using "Navigate to point" outside of a mission, hotkey appears on screen
 Added an option to invert the camera Y-Axis

UI Changes:

 Added an option to hide the mini-map in first person view
 Improved multiplayer game room selection screen.
 Updated player list to accommodate scrolling with controllers

Bug Fixes:

 Fixed parking collider issue with tandem trailers
 Fixed Car Transporter license plate not animating
 Fixed issues with fuel depletion
 Fixed Blank UI after convoy invite
 Fixed or mitigated the navigation bug (old routes being displayed)
 Fixed interior camera rotating when paused and moving the map 

Other Changes:

 Adjusted mission income
 On mission invite, when you click the convoy mission but lack the equipment, it’s no longer necessary to return to the garage


See our Trello Roadmap here: https://trello.com/b/uon15eED/truck-logistics-simulator-roadmap

notes.title: A dev-blog about progress with the biggest update so far.
notes.notes:
Convoy Escort in Multiplayer
Convoy escort missions are almost completed. All vans, pickups, and cars will have purchasable convoy equipment which will allow you to escort logistics convoys in multiplayer.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36744579/abfd48116f2bc485498be5458c7b0f584e48464f.png

Map Extension
A new 8 square-kilometer region will be added to the map in this update which will extend the mission length, allow longer duration missions, and will also provide alternative routes with mountain roads. The map extension is 90% completed but currently has many issues that we are currently working on.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36744579/5f78a484a38264e6ddac2430704dbeaa7eea02eb.jpg

New Missions
Here are screenshots of some of the new missions that are currently in testing;

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36744579/11852374aada9bcbfd012cf90a169adcedb40b4a.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36744579/98680ab01333b45b284c31930c9b7351db854eeb.gif

Vehicles
There are more new vehicles than what we announced earlier. We added 6x4 versions of the trucks and remodeled around 50% of their exteriors. 

We added a new modern truck which is still in integration. We added towing capacity to vehicles that vary between models and some vehicles can’t support heavier cargo missions.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36744579/d16ecf1469acdca80bc5e4f44513cef58bd834d5.jpg

A new minivan is also completed and integrated into the game. There are many new cargoes like a camping caravan or a generator.

There are many other small features like Cruise Control support and improvements in the environment with moving ships or aircraft. There are many UI improvements including the ability to navigate to any point on the map using the mid-mouse click or seeing which missions a vehicle can support.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36744579/a1221675751203c4cad03520fac11d67340e1959.jpg

We also improved vehicle physics by improved collision meshes of all vehicles and better brake handling for trailers.

Test Drive
We added a “Test Drive” function to vehicles before you purchase them. This feature allows you to test any mission available in the game without owning the vehicle similar to a sandbox mode.

Future plans
For the future, company management is a major feature that is currently in development. You will be able to create a company with a name and a logo and hire AI drivers for this company.
You will also be able to purchase vehicles and assign them to AI drivers, based on their experience and driving licences. Each AI driver and also your own driver profile will improve and level up after completing logistics missions and you will choose which licences to progress first. 

The company management and driver profile features will probably be released with the version in which we get out of early access and make the full release of the game. We can't tell when exactly that will be. However, we want to share our plans with you already. 

The big update with the map extension, the new missions etc. will be coming soon.

To follow the latest news, join our Discord server:
https://discord.gg/PCjxFjs

You can read more about the new features and improvements in the changelog:

* TrackIR Support.
* Improved multiplayer synchronization for better physics interactions.
* Rearview mirrors of small vehicles are now functional.

notes.title: Truck & Logistics Simulator: Big Spring Update 1

Good news everyone!

The new big Truck & Logistics Simulator Spring Update 1 is here! 

These are the highlights:


 LOAD SECURING
 NEW LOCATIONS
 IMPROVED OPEN WORLD
 IMPROVED VEHICLES
 IMPROVED DRIVING PHYSICS
 IMPROVED AI
 PERFORMANCE OPTIMIZATIONS


Watch the trailer now:

[previewyoutube=8TdaxmmfxRM;full][/previewyoutube]

You can find out more details in the complete changelog:

Missions
* Added Cargo Straps and chains to fasten the loads
* Forklift loaded truck missions now have an additional pallet of cargo.

Physics
* Updated vehicle suspensions and tire physics to increase realism.
* Improved the interaction between trailer and towing vehicle.
* Added physically responsive axle models to vehicles.
* Added "Steering Sensitivity" options to adjust steering behavior with gamepad and keyboard.
* Collision physics between Forklift and pallets are improved

Vehicles
* Added fuel, temperature gauges and dashboard lights to all vehicles.
* Added interior seat position option for Up-Down.
* Improved wheel and rim models of most of the vehicles.
* Updated vehicle prices.

Graphics, Optimization
* Custom graphics settings. (Shadow Quality, motion blur and etc.)
* Graphics optimization, up to 90% increase of FPS.
* Significantly improved reflections and night lighting.
* Added Frame Rate Limit (Max FPS) to graphics options.
* Improved lighting and shadows.
* Added clouds to mirror reflections.

Environment
* Added old towns to the existing map with narrow roads.
* Many new mountain roads.
* New European style traffic lights and traffic signs.
* Increased the visual clarity of the terrain.
* Reduced bumpiness and improved the curve on some roads.

Traffic
* Traffic AI is significantly improved.
* Added "Traffic Density Slider"

Audio
* Added reverb effect to tunnels.

User Interface
* Increased refresh rate of the minimap.
* User Interface (UI) mirror setting is now persistent.
* Recreated the vehicle images in the UI with better contrast.

Multiplayer
* Traffic lights are now synchronized in multiplayer.
* Added an option in the multiplayer player list to disable collisions with all players.
* Trailers turn signals, reverse and etc. are now also synchronized.

Bug Fixes
* Improvements and bug fixes to manual gear shifting and H-Shifter support.
* When recovering your vehicle or restarting a mission now the game disables collisions to avoid glitches in multiplayer.

Other
*Fullscreen is extended with more options. In the screen resolutions, refresh rate is also selectable.

notes.title: A quick update about the development!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36744579/0fdd18f4af890457331328d37f90e3ada28b0e9d.jpg
Here is a quick update about the development!

The new minivan is about 90% complete. The team has been working on improving the map, starting with the map extension, new traffic signs, new European style traffic lights, a new mission, and so on.

But the work-in-progress graphics optimization caused a big delay in updates. This required a major rewrite in the code and that caused lots of new bugs and instability. We're hoping to see it completed next week and then we can release an update.

Development of the company management feature has started. It will take about 6 months of time to develop.

These are the current changelog for the next update. More might be added and we will make a separate announcement when update is ready. Not yet released, planning to release in a week:

Separated Graphics Settings to allow better customization and optimization. (Shadow Quality, motion blur and etc.)
New European style traffic signs.
Improved wheel and rim models of most of the vehicles.
When recovering your vehicle or restarting a mission now the game disables collisions temporarily to avoid collisions in multiplayer.
User Interface (UI) mirror setting is now persistent.
Added interior seat position option for Up-Down. (Was only forward-back)
Added Frame Rate Limit (Max FPS) to graphics options.
Recreated the vehicle images in the UI.
Added physically responsive axle models to some vehicles.
Increased fuel consumption of vehicles.
Disabled audio in the pause menu.
Improvements and bug fixes to manual gear shifting and H-Shifter support.
Many fixes with the map. Reduced bumpiness and improved the curve on some roads.
User interface improvements.
This isn't the big update that includes a new minivan, rain and more. That big update is planned to be released in 3 weeks we will announce it closer to release. It will also be released on Nintendo Switch at the same time.

Your Truck & Logistics team

notes.title: Truck and Logistics Simulator | Update v0.9648
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36744579/1b5b1f48d4e18a9a21bea35b9c74145646293a40.png
A small bugfix update for Truck & Logistics Simulator. Full changelog:

 Fixed the customization camera bug.
 Fixed the issue with interior camera rotation with controller.
 Added mod* button to control mapping. 
 Fixed Dump Trucks fuel tank save/load issue.
 Fixed load vehicles showing wrong hotkey for second axis.

*: Mod button is used for controllers for second vehicle axis, camera zoom, and quick chat in multiplayer.

The default controls are updated. To receive the updated control maps, please use "revert to default" from the control mapper.

As always, the version is updated on the Beta branch first, and after a few hours, will also be available on the default branch.

Your Truck & Logistics team

notes.title: Truck and Logistics Simulator | Update v0.9647
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36744579/1b5b1f48d4e18a9a21bea35b9c74145646293a40.png
Fourth update is available now, here is the full changelog:

 Manual transmission, Sequential, or H-Shifter.
 Option to disable Auto-Reverse. Manually shift to reverse gear.
 Camera now rotates without holding the mouse button.
 "Time of day" settings moved to pause menu.
 Allowed UI Scale slider to go lower, scaling the UI smaller.
 Steering delay and steering assist are disabled when control is Steering Wheel.
 Improved the suspension of the sedan car.
 Fixed player names bug in multiplayer that caused names to not appear.
 Minor bugfixes.


The default controls are updated. To receive the updated control maps, please use "revert to default" from the control mapper.

As always, version is updated on the Beta branch first, and after a few hours, will also ve available on the default branch.

Your Truck & Logistics team

notes.title: Truck and Logistics Simulator | Update v0.9646
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36744579/1b5b1f48d4e18a9a21bea35b9c74145646293a40.png
Third update is available now, here is the full changelog:
Optimized performance of shadows.
Optimized memory usage and reduced map loading times.
Improved performance for old graphics cards that don't support compute shaders.
Added V-Sync toggle in options.
Zooming out the minimap now works and it can be resized bigger.
Time of day slider settings(timescale, system time/simulated/none) are now saved.
Increased camera rotation speeds with controllers.
Fixed keyboard binding of wipers and hazard lights.
Fixed light brightness of tandem box trailer.
The game now auto hides cursor when driving a loader with the right mouse button.
Fixed issue with street light brightness at night.
Fixed lighting of the lake material.
Disabled rain temporarily as it's still WIP and isn't supposed to be visible.
Improved environment and vegetation


Your Truck & Logistics team
